source_findings_paraphrased: Unsupported PreToolUse control fields may produce hook errors while the original tool call continues.
MCP hook errors, missing servers and unavailable tools do not block the operation.
PostToolUse cannot undo already executed side effects.
engineering_consequence: Hooks are defense-in-depth guardrails, not an OS isolation boundary. Post-run evidence gating rejects unqualified results but does not retroactively prevent effects.
local_findings: Native judge clone previously did not forward an explicitly supplied guard. Calls189–191 did not configure any guard, so this is not evidence their guard was removed.

Guard config and script identity were recorded at runner construction but not rechecked at command build. Now rechecked, including Python executable, before reserve. This does not lock them during execution.
